title: MC Redux
description: Modpack which gives a vanilla friendly overhaul to Minecraft.
body:
MC Redux is a modpack that aims to overhaul parts of vanilla minecraft that I believe were lacking in quality of life, functionality, or detail, whilst keeping the core parts of minecraft that are already perfect intact. This mod is perfect for anyone who loves vanilla minecraft but wants to see slightly more improvements and content that blends in seamlessly with the rest of the game.

In short, this modpack adds upgrades to already existing structures thanks to the Yung's Better Structures mods, discontinued mobs from mob votes have also been added to the game thanks to the friends and foes mod, among many more!
